notes.title: 85% for Summer Sale and Trading Cards now available!
notes.notes: In honor the Steam Summer Sale we are putting the game on sale for 85% off, and we have added Steam Trading Cards. The set will feature 5 cards, 5 emoticons, and 3 backgrounds. We hope you enjoy this addition. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Gun Metal, 10% off!
notes.notes:
Gun Metal is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off*!

Gun Metal is a futuristic action-packed experience where you take control of the fully transformable prototype combat vehicle known as the Havoc Suit. The Havoc Suit, a prototype combat vehicle, remains the only hope to save civilization from a tireless enemy. Standing 10 meters tall, with an arsenal of devastating weaponry and the ability to transform instantly into an agile jet, only this formidable battle machine has the potential to halt the invaders! Use the Havoc Suit to battle-ground-based enemies, or transform in the blink of an eye into an agile jet and take on aircraft in high-speed dogfights. Either way, get ready for mind-blowing action and out-of-this world graphics.

*Offer ends January 23rd at 10AM Pacific time.
